## Moved from GitHub issues on 2026-10-14

Open GitHub issues of mas-bandwidth/fixed3d, recorded here on 2026-10-14 when roadmaps became the standard for future work (Glenn, 2026-10-14). Each item names its issue; the issue is closed with a pointer here.

### Port the box3d follow-cam / world-text sample viewer (upstream 3fc20f5), held for a bench with a display

Upstream 3fc20f5 'Follow cam (#107)' (2026-07-29) carries a sample-viewer feature that the 2026-08-22 port pass deliberately did not take across. The engine, CI and constants half of that commit is ported (see the port commit on the port branch), and the cursor moves past it with this issue as the named exception, so nothing is hidden.

From: mas-bandwidth/fixed3d issue #20, opened 2026-08-22 by rowan-claude; moved here 2026-10-14

### Baked-geometry version constants do not distinguish LUDICROUS_MODE, so a cross-config blob passes the guard and is read 48 bytes short

The three baked-geometry version constants — B3_HULL_VERSION, B3_MESH_VERSION and B3_HEIGHT_FIELD_VERSION — are plain #defines in a public header and take the same value in both build configurations. The layouts they exist to certify do not.

From: mas-bandwidth/fixed3d issue #25, opened 2026-08-23 by rowan-claude; moved here 2026-10-14

### Move the fixed-point core to the fixed library; fixed3d keeps b3-named wrappers

Glenn's call, 2026-08-24, from one function outward to the class: 'isn't this a class of functions that should be moved out to 'fixed' library? Surely converting a fixed point to double is fixed library functionality, not fixed3d (although fixed3d can totally export it, that's fine).'

From: mas-bandwidth/fixed3d issue #27, opened 2026-08-23 by gafferongames; moved here 2026-10-14

### Precision-envelope audit: find every magnitude-dependent failure, make the arithmetic loud

Glenn's question (2026-08-24), after invMass (#29) and the inertia inversion (#30) both proved broken at scale: are there OTHER parts needing expanded precision? The class signature: inverses of large quantities (underflow to zero or garbage), products of large quantities in reductions (overflow, wrapped casts), silent truncation at int64 casts, and ...

From: mas-bandwidth/fixed3d issue #31, opened 2026-08-24 by gafferongames; moved here 2026-10-14

### Centre of mass multiplies by the truncated reciprocal, so it collapses to the body origin for heavy bodies

Found while fixing #29, deliberately NOT bundled with it because the fix perturbs every body and trips an assert that needs its own investigation. b3UpdateBodyMassData (src/body.c) accumulates localCenter = sum( mass_i * center_i ) and then divides by the total mass by multiplying by the reciprocal:

From: mas-bandwidth/fixed3d issue #32, opened 2026-08-24 by gafferongames; moved here 2026-10-14

### Angular damping has a resolution floor: a slow-spinning large body never damps at all

b3IntegrateVelocitiesTask (src/solver.c) damps by multiplying: b3FixMul rounds half up. So a Q48.16 angular velocity component only moves when the per-substep decrement clears half a quantum: Below that, every component is a fixed point of the multiply and the spin holds forever. Not 'damps slowly' — does not change at all, for any number of steps.

From: mas-bandwidth/fixed3d issue #41, opened 2026-08-24 by gafferongames; moved here 2026-10-14

### Port the samples half of box3d 47d7f7c (character mover, issues, joint)

Upstream 47d7f7c 'clockwise option, joint is awake (#130)' carries a samples half that PR #46 deliberately does not take: samples/sample_character.cpp (225 lines) — mover behavior against the new b3Body_TimeOfImpactMover and the new b3PlaneResult indices samples/sample_issues.cpp (84 lines) samples/sample_joint.cpp (65 lines) — exercises b3Joint_IsAwake ...

From: mas-bandwidth/fixed3d issue #47, opened 2026-08-30 by rowan-claude; moved here 2026-10-14

### Height field shape-cast legs changed proxy order and shift origin for clockwise fields, recorded as a pure refactor

Issue #50 asked for a measurement rather than an argument; it was taken in 7ae09e6 on sprint/fixed3d-box3d-ports (card fixed3d-issue-50). Pre-change bddc87f against post-change 135e64a, 1000 seeded b3ShapeCastHeightField casts per proxy: the counter-clockwise control is bit-identical; on a clockwise field 1738 of 3000 casts differ, every difference a hit-to-miss flip from the new back-side culling, and the post-change build records zero hits on any clockwise field from an above-ground query (flat field included). Casts both builds hit are bit-identical. What remains is the decision the measurement recorded as Glenn's: keep upstream's culling for clockwise height fields, or restore the old spelling, then pin the chosen behaviour with a test.

Why it waits: Triage 2026-10-15: the measurement half is done; the keep-or-restore decision is open, so the item stays.

From: mas-bandwidth/fixed3d issue #50, opened 2026-09-01 by rowan-claude; moved here 2026-10-14

### Mover mesh collide feeds the winding-swapped vertex order to GJK, not just to the cull

b3CollideMoverAndMesh now swaps vertex2 and vertex3 when the mesh scale is not counter clockwise, and the swap happens before the vertices are used for anything. The swapped order reaches triangleVertices, which is handed to GJK as proxyA, not only to the new signed volume cull that actually needs the orientation.

From: mas-bandwidth/fixed3d issue #51, opened 2026-09-01 by rowan-claude; moved here 2026-10-14

### Height field cull spells triangle 2 as two different cyclic rotations across its two sites

The height field spells the second cell triangle two different ways. The shape-cast cull uses b3SignedVolume of point21, point22, point12, and the mover cull uses b3SignedVolume of point22, point12, point21.

From: mas-bandwidth/fixed3d issue #53, opened 2026-09-01 by rowan-claude; moved here 2026-10-14

### Runtime ISA dispatch for fixed3d, the interface: the variant table, the registration point and the scalar equivalence test

OWNER RULING (2026-10-15): fixed3d must be deterministic itself, bit-identical across runs, worker counts and platforms; it may diverge slightly from box3d. Every ISA variant is bit-identical to the scalar variant, so a mixed fleet stays in lockstep. Source: split from fixed3d-isa-dispatch-core by the needs audit of 2026-10-15 afternoon: the dispatch core held 20 cards, and the avx2 spike and the NEON card use only its interface (the variant table, the registration point, the name-based force and the equivalence test), not its AVX-512 variant, its x86 CI or its AVX-512 bench gate. The owner, 2026-10-15 13:54Z: "I don't want to have to for example, have to do a build per-instruction set. They should all be automatically detected and used, where appropriate." Work so far, audited 2026-10-15: no head of its own; it builds on fixed3d-isa-dispatch-core, whose heads are all on origin (see that item). Not on origin: none.

Why it waits: Scoped out of the sprint by Glenn 2026-10-15 ("I want nothing in it except the tools/sprint work and rocketnet and schema. The rest should go out to the appropriate roadmap."): not tools/sprint, rocketnet or schema work.

## Upstream box3d past the 2026-10-09 plan: 5d83df8..efca0c1, triaged 2026-10-16

The four upstream commits after plan #65's range (box3d 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-15), triaged by the daily Box3D to Fixed3D pass on 2026-10-16 against the integration branch sprint/fixed3d-box3d-ports. Oldest first: a2e4816 'Fixes for #175 (#187)' is PORTED on that branch (card fixed3d-box3d-ports-manifold-block, PR #75: the speculative margin in the sphere and capsule routines, the recycle flag only when speculative points are on, a freed manifold invalidates the recycling cache; its docs/faq.md hunk is skipped as docs). 8128d74 'Discussion template (#185)' is SKIPPED: a .github discussion template, repository configuration for upstream's own discussions, no simulation content. 0cfc475 'Solver stuff (#189)' is HELD for a design-first port step, the first item below. efca0c1 'Gyro tolerance (#191)' is PORTED, engine half, carried ahead of the cursor, the second item below until its PR merges. The cursor clause in CLAUDE.md on the integration branch names the same four; nothing here moves the cursor, which advances with PR #94.

### Port 0cfc475 'Solver stuff (#189)': the revolute and spherical axial solve merge, design first; the point-constraint helper is already satisfied

Upstream 0cfc475 (2026-10-14) does three things. (1) A new b3SolvePointConstraint in src/joint.h expands skew(r) * invI * skew(r) term by term and solves the 3x3 system by cofactors with a 1000 * FLT_MIN determinant guard, replacing b3Skew + b3MulMM + b3Solve3 in the motor, weld, revolute and spherical joints. ALREADY SATISFIED here in structure: fixed3d's joints build K with b3SkewSandwich and solve with b3Solve3AcrossScales (src/motor_joint.c 380-387, weld 279-286, revolute 586-593, spherical 662-669), and the float determinant guard has no fixed-point analogue because b3Solve3AcrossScales carries its own refusal. Verify term by term, then claim it in the record. (2) The revolute and spherical joints merge their spring, motor and limit solves into one block that holds a running cdot, precomputes the inverse-inertia response of the axis once, and applies the accumulated impulse to wA and wB once at the end, instead of re-reading wB - wA after each sub-solve. In Q48.16 that is a reassociation, not a rewrite (CLAUDE.md hard-won rule: reassociations are not free; b3Lerp moved a ragdoll sleep step 287 to 453), so it moves goldens; upstream's own goldens moved for every scene in both precisions (ragdoll, wave pile, query spawn, mesh drop). Port it as its own step with every golden harvested in narrow and ludicrous modes across worker counts 1 to 5 and attributed, or refuse it with the measurement; decide after a design read, not before. (3) The contact_solver_wide.inl hunk has no analogue: fixed3d has its own wide solver gated to AVX-512. b3Skew is deleted upstream and has no users here either; delete it with the step.

Why it waits: Triage 2026-10-16 by the daily pass: a solver reassociation that moves goldens needs a design step before code, per the port rules; held rather than skipped because the merged axial solve is the live upstream spelling the next joint commit will build on.

From: upstream erincatto/box3d 0cfc475 'Solver stuff (#189)' (2026-10-14), triaged 2026-10-16 by the daily Box3D to Fixed3D pass

### Port efca0c1 'Gyro tolerance (#191)': an isotropic inertia tolerance gates gyroscopic torque

Upstream efca0c1 (2026-10-15) adds b3WorldDef::isotropicInertiaTolerance (default 0.2, clamped [0, 1]) with set and get, a recorded op and a snapshot field; computes the squared Frobenius norm of the inertia deviator and sets a new body flag b3_enableGyroscopicTorque only when 2 * deviation > 3 * tolerance^2 * mean^2; runs the gyroscopic Newton-Raphson only under the flag; moves the local inertia from b3Body to b3BodySim and reads it directly in the solve; renames b3_bodyEnableContactRecycling to b3_enableContactRecycling. Fixed-point decisions taken for the port: the tolerance is a b3Fixed; the isotropy test is computed in exact 128-bit raw products (a b3FixMul of two values below about 0.004 is zero, and the deviations of a half-meter body are in that range), with the mean as the raw trace divided by 3; the inertia field moves to b3BodySim and the gyro solve reads the true inertia, retiring the stored round-trip inertiaLocal (goldens move anyway for the gating); the field move and the gating are separate commits so each golden move is attributed; sizeof( b3Body ) and sizeof( b3BodySim ) measured in both configs; recording op 0x70 with minor version 8 to 9 and snapshot version 5 to 6. The samples hunk (sample_bodies.cpp) is held under the standing samples hold (#20, #47). Red first: upstream's two body tests ported to Q48.16 and seen failing before the gating exists.

Already in the code: Work in progress 2026-10-16 on branch port/efca0c1-gyro-tolerance against sprint/fixed3d-box3d-ports; resume from it, do not start over.

Why it waits: Triage 2026-10-16 by the daily pass: PORT, engine half, carried ahead of the cursor; an independent change with its own tests and no dependency on the open f555ee4 and 16f7f4c steps.

From: upstream erincatto/box3d efca0c1 'Gyro tolerance (#191)' (2026-10-15), triaged 2026-10-16 by the daily Box3D to Fixed3D pass
